name: Nvidia-Status
description: NVIDIA GPU dashboard + exporter — shows the GDDR6/GDDR6X VRAM & junction temps that nvidia-smi hides on consumer RTX 30/40 cards, plus detailed stats including per-Docker-container resource usage. Exports to Prometheus, JSON, MQTT/Home Assistant and InfluxDB out of the box for long-term analysis. Reports (per GPU): core/junction/VRAM temps + thresholds, clocks, power + limits, utilisation, VRAM, fan, PCIe gen/width + live bandwidth, throttle reasons, per-process usage mapped to the owning Docker container, and NVENC sessions (codec + resolution). Optional per-GPU power-limit control. Multi-GPU aware. Configure from the built-in Settings page or the variables below. Requires the Unraid Nvidia-Driver plugin. SECURITY: reads GPU BAR0 via SYS_RAWIO + /dev/mem (needed for the hidden junction/VRAM temps). Per-process container mapping needs --pid=host + --cgroupns=host + the read-only docker containers mount (all pre-set below). Power-limit control additionally requires Privileged=on.

paths.name: Container names (ro)
paths.description: Read-only mount so GPU processes can be mapped to container names

variables.name: GPUs
variables.description: Which GPUs to expose (all, or a UUID/index)

variables.name: Mode
variables.description: prometheus = web/HTTP server (normal). json = print JSON lines to the log instead.

variables.name: Node name
variables.description: Identifier used in MQTT topics, InfluxDB tags and the HA device name. Defaults to the hostname.

variables.name: Enable MQTT
variables.description: Publish to MQTT if a broker host is set below (1=on, 0=off)

variables.name: Enable InfluxDB
variables.description: Write to InfluxDB if a URL is set below (1=on, 0=off)

variables.name: MQTT broker host
variables.description: MQTT broker IP/host. Blank = MQTT off.

variables.name: MQTT username
variables.description: MQTT username (if the broker needs auth)

variables.name: InfluxDB write interval (s)
variables.description: How often to write to InfluxDB

variables.name: InfluxDB token (v2)
variables.description: v2 API token (presence selects the v2 API)

variables.name: Enable power-limit control
variables.description: Allow setting the GPU power limit from the Settings page. Also requires Privileged = ON (advanced view). Default 0 = read-only.

variables.name: Power-limit min (clamp)
variables.description: Optional lower clamp (watts). Blank = use the GPU's own minimum.

variables.name: Power-limit max (clamp)
variables.description: Optional upper clamp (watts). Blank = use the GPU's own maximum.
